create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.head: Гипертруба Accelerators
create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.text: Гипертруба Accelerators increase the speed of entities traveling the Гипертруба.
You can change to BRAKE mode by Right Clicking the Accelerator.
create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.head: Гипертруба Attachments
create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.text: The Scanner Attachment allows you to detect entities traveling the Гипертруба. (8 power for babies and 15 for adults)
You can also place attachments in accelerators, in any side at the same time.
The Редстоун Detector Attachment allows you to change the Accelerator/Entrance mode with a Редстоун signal.
create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_1: Гипертруба Entrances connect to the Гипертруба сеть, allowing high-speed travel.
create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_2: To be able to enter the Гипертруба, you need to power with at least 16 RPM.
create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_3: The faster it spins, the faster you can travel.
create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_4: You can change the entrance mode by Right Clicking it with a Wrench.
create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.head: Creating a Гипертруба
create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.text: To create a Гипертруба connection, Just Right Click the tube while holding another tube.
And you have a Гипертруба connection!
You can connect already placed tubes.
You can change tube segment count with the wrench.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_1: The Гипертруба Splitter can link up to three tubes, branching a line into multiple paths.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_2: While traveling, you can pick where to go with your movement keys.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_3: Right Click it with a Wrench to cycle through the Splitter modes.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_4: On Continue mode, travelers always keep going through the side tubes.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_5: On Center mode, travelers are always routed through the front tube.
create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_6: A Редстоун Detector Attachment can toggle between both forced modes.
